title: Require Domain Source Topology
forbids: domain roots outside the positive domain blueprint spine
why: A domain root has one closed public source shape. The domain blueprint owns only that direct spine; operation, model, and artifact kinds own their own internal topology.
remediate: Keep the required domain entrypoints and owner directories at the domain root, move optional artifacts into the admitted artifact slot, and relocate every other direct child to its actual kind owner.
message: Domain roots must match the positive domain blueprint spine.
